root_cause_criterion.criterion: At the nonzero previous-member lookup inside `get_struct_layout_string()`, the members array used for `prev_member` must be the same iterated struct array `st->Members()`, not the captured outer `str->Members()` array.
root_cause_criterion.description: The vulnerable helper reaches the first outer-out-of-bounds iteration with `prev_lookup_members_base` still set to the captured outer `str->Members().data()` while `loop_members_base` is the inner `st->Members().data()`. The fixed code reaches the same protected event with both bases equal because it indexes `st->Members()[i - 1]`.

nodes.state: At the AddressSanitizer sink iteration, `i - 1 >= str->Members().size()`, so indexing the outer semantic struct member array would read past the copied heap allocation.

edges.relation: The outer semantic struct selected from the uniform variable at line 438 is the same outer `Members()` array later still available at the nested `prev_member` lookup site.
The inner semantic struct chosen as `member_str` for the nested layout note is the same `st` whose `Members()` array drives the helper loop at the sink site.
